en.g: Prepare clear, confident answers to typical interview questions.
p: Tell me about yourself: role, experience, one strength. I'm a designer with five years' experience in...
Strengths and weaknesses: I'm very organised. I'm working on public speaking, so I've joined a course.
Why this job? I'm keen to... I'd love to bring my skills in... Ask them: What does a typical day look like?
en.q: Let's practise! Tell me about yourself in three sentences, as if I were the interviewer.
en.c: Write answers to three questions: Tell me about yourself. What are your strengths? Why do you want this job?

de.g: Du bereitest klare, selbstbewusste Antworten auf typische Interviewfragen vor.

de.c: Schreib Antworten auf drei Fragen: Tell me about yourself. What are your strengths? Why do you want this job?

es.q: ¡Practiquemos! Háblame de ti en tres frases, como si yo fuera el entrevistador.
es.c: Escribe respuestas a tres preguntas: Tell me about yourself. What are your strengths? Why do you want this job?

it.c: Scrivi le risposte a tre domande: Tell me about yourself. What are your strengths? Why do you want this job?

vocab.ex: Tell me about yourself and your experience.
One of my strengths is solving problems quickly.

I'm a team player and I enjoy helping others.

target.gram: Interviews: present simple for facts (I work in...), present perfect for experience (I've managed...), I'm keen to for goals.

en.g: Write a clear English CV with action verbs, sections and short lines.
p: Sections: Profile, Work experience, Education, Skills, Languages. Most recent job first.
Start lines with action verbs, no I: Managed a team of five. Designed a new website. Improved sales by 20%.
Keep it short and easy to scan: one or two pages, clear dates, the same style for every line.
en.q: Which three action verbs best describe what you do or did in your work or studies?
en.c: Write a three-line Profile and three bullet-style lines for one job, each starting with an action verb.

de.g: Du schreibst einen klaren englischen Lebenslauf mit Aktionsverben, Abschnitten und kurzen Zeilen.
p: Abschnitte: Profile, Work experience, Education, Skills, Languages. Die neueste Stelle zuerst.
Zeilen mit Aktionsverben beginnen, ohne I: Managed a team of five. Designed a new website. Improved sales by 20%.
Kurz und leicht lesbar: ein bis zwei Seiten, klare Daten, überall der gleiche Stil.
de.q: Welche drei Aktionsverben beschreiben am besten, was du bei der Arbeit oder im Studium machst oder gemacht hast?
de.c: Schreib ein Profil in drei Zeilen und drei Stichpunkte zu einer Stelle, jeder mit einem Aktionsverb am Anfang.

es.g: Escribe un CV en inglés claro, con verbos de acción, secciones y líneas cortas.
p: Secciones: Profile, Work experience, Education, Skills, Languages. El trabajo más reciente primero.
Empieza con verbos de acción, sin I: Managed a team of five. Designed a new website. Improved sales by 20%.
Que sea breve y fácil de leer: una o dos páginas, fechas claras y el mismo estilo en cada línea.
es.q: ¿Qué tres verbos de acción describen mejor lo que haces o hiciste en tu trabajo o tus estudios?
es.c: Escribe un Profile de tres líneas y tres viñetas para un puesto, cada una con un verbo de acción.

fr.g: Rédige un CV anglais clair avec des verbes d'action, des rubriques et des lignes courtes.
p: Rubriques : Profile, Work experience, Education, Skills, Languages. Le poste le plus récent en premier.
Commence par un verbe d'action, sans I : Managed a team of five. Designed a new website. Improved sales by 20%.
Fais court et lisible : une ou deux pages, des dates claires, le même style à chaque ligne.
fr.q: Quels trois verbes d'action décrivent le mieux ce que tu fais ou as fait au travail ou en études ?
fr.c: Écris un Profile de trois lignes et trois puces pour un poste, chacune commençant par un verbe d'action.

it.g: Scrivi un CV in inglese chiaro, con verbi d'azione, sezioni e righe brevi.
p: Sezioni: Profile, Work experience, Education, Skills, Languages. Il lavoro più recente per primo.
Inizia con verbi d'azione, senza I: Managed a team of five. Designed a new website. Improved sales by 20%.
Breve e facile da leggere: una o due pagine, date chiare e lo stesso stile in ogni riga.
it.q: Quali tre verbi d'azione descrivono meglio ciò che fai o hai fatto nel lavoro o negli studi?
it.c: Scrivi un Profile di tre righe e tre punti per un lavoro, ognuno con un verbo d'azione all'inizio.

pt.g: Escreve um CV em inglês claro, com verbos de ação, secções e linhas curtas.
p: Secções: Profile, Work experience, Education, Skills, Languages. O emprego mais recente primeiro.
Começa com verbos de ação, sem I: Managed a team of five. Designed a new website. Improved sales by 20%.
Curto e fácil de ler: uma ou duas páginas, datas claras e o mesmo estilo em todas as linhas.
pt.q: Que três verbos de ação descrevem melhor o que fazes ou fizeste no trabalho ou nos estudos?
pt.c: Escreve um Profile de três linhas e três tópicos para um emprego, cada um a começar com um verbo de ação.

pt_BR.g: Escreva um currículo em inglês claro, com verbos de ação, seções e linhas curtas.

Comece com verbos de ação, sem I: Managed a team of five. Designed a new website. Improved sales by 20%.
Curto e fácil de ler: uma ou duas páginas, datas claras e o mesmo estilo em todas as linhas.
pt_BR.q: Quais três verbos de ação descrevem melhor o que você faz ou fez no trabalho ou nos estudos?
pt_BR.c: Escreva um Profile de três linhas e três tópicos para um emprego, cada um começando com um verbo de ação.

vocab.ex: Managed a team of eight customer advisers.
Designed a new booking system for the clinic.
Improved delivery times by 15%.
Led weekly training sessions for new staff.
List your work experience with the newest job first.
Skills: Excel, presentations, Spanish (fluent).

target.gram: CV style: start lines with past-tense action verbs and no subject (Managed..., Created...); use present tense only for your current job.

en.g: Take part in a meeting politely: give opinions, add ideas and disagree kindly.
p: Giving a view: From my point of view... I think we should... In my experience...
Joining in: Could I add something? Sorry to interrupt, but... Can I just come in here?
Agreeing and disagreeing: I completely agree. I see what you mean, but... I'm not sure that's the best option.
en.q: Imagine your team wants to change the office hours. Give your view in two or three sentences.
en.c: Write a mini meeting: one person suggests an idea, you add something, someone disagrees politely, you agree on a plan.

de.g: Du beteiligst dich höflich an Meetings: Meinung sagen, Ideen ergänzen, freundlich widersprechen.
p: Meinung: From my point of view... I think we should... In my experience...
Einsteigen: Could I add something? Sorry to interrupt, but... Can I just come in here?
Zustimmen und widersprechen: I completely agree. I see what you mean, but... I'm not sure that's the best option.
de.q: Stell dir vor, dein Team will die Bürozeiten ändern. Sag deine Meinung in zwei oder drei Sätzen.
de.c: Schreib ein Mini-Meeting: jemand schlägt etwas vor, du ergänzt, jemand widerspricht höflich, ihr einigt euch.

es.g: Participa en una reunión con educación: opina, añade ideas y discrepa con amabilidad.
p: Opinar: From my point of view... I think we should... In my experience...
Intervenir: Could I add something? Sorry to interrupt, but... Can I just come in here?
Estar de acuerdo o no: I completely agree. I see what you mean, but... I'm not sure that's the best option.
es.q: Imagina que tu equipo quiere cambiar el horario de la oficina. Da tu opinión en dos o tres frases.
es.c: Escribe una mini reunión: alguien propone algo, tú añades algo, otro discrepa con educación y acordáis un plan.

fr.g: Participe poliment à une réunion : donne ton avis, ajoute une idée, exprime un désaccord avec tact.
p: Donner son avis : From my point of view... I think we should... In my experience...
Intervenir : Could I add something? Sorry to interrupt, but... Can I just come in here?
Être d'accord ou non : I completely agree. I see what you mean, but... I'm not sure that's the best option.
fr.q: Imagine que ton équipe veut changer les horaires du bureau. Donne ton avis en deux ou trois phrases.
fr.c: Écris une mini réunion : quelqu'un propose, tu ajoutes une idée, un autre n'est pas d'accord poliment, vous décidez.

it.g: Partecipa a una riunione con garbo: dai la tua opinione, aggiungi idee e dissenti con gentilezza.

Concordare o no: I completely agree. I see what you mean, but... I'm not sure that's the best option.
it.q: Immagina che il tuo team voglia cambiare l'orario d'ufficio. Dai la tua opinione in due o tre frasi.
it.c: Scrivi una mini riunione: qualcuno propone, tu aggiungi un'idea, un altro dissente con garbo, decidete un piano.

vocab.w: I see what you mean, but

target.gram: Meetings: soft opinions (From my point of view), polite interrupting (Could I add...?) and soft disagreeing (I see what you mean, but).

en.g: Write clear, polite work emails with standard phrases.
p: Opening: Dear Ms Lee, / Hi Tom, Thanks for your email. I'm writing to ask about...
Middle: Please find attached the report. Could you let me know by Friday? I'd be grateful if...
Closing: I look forward to hearing from you. Best regards, / Kind regards, + your name.
en.q: Who do you usually write emails to, and do you prefer a formal or a friendly style?
en.c: Write a short email to a colleague: say why you're writing, attach a file, ask for a reply by a date and close politely.

de.g: Du schreibst klare, höfliche Arbeits-E-Mails mit Standardformulierungen.

Schluss: I look forward to hearing from you. Best regards, / Kind regards, + dein Name.

fr.c: Écris un court e-mail à un collègue : le motif, une pièce jointe, une réponse demandée avant une date et une formule finale.

en.g: Give a short professional introduction: role, experience and goals.
p: Role: I'm a project manager at a software company. I work in the marketing team.
Experience: I've been working in this field for six years. Before that, I worked as a teacher.
Goals: I'm currently focusing on... I'm hoping to move into... I'd love to connect with people who...
en.q: Introduce yourself to me as if we were at a professional event. What do you do, and what are you hoping to do next?
en.c: Write a 30-second introduction with your role, your experience (present perfect continuous) and one goal.

de.g: Du stellst dich kurz und professionell vor: Rolle, Erfahrung und Ziele.

de.c: Schreib eine 30-Sekunden-Vorstellung mit Rolle, Erfahrung (Present Perfect Continuous) und einem Ziel.

es.c: Escribe una presentación de 30 segundos con tu puesto, tu experiencia (present perfect continuous) y un objetivo.

fr.c: Écris une présentation de 30 secondes avec ton poste, ton expérience (present perfect continuous) et un objectif.

en.g: Reach a friendly agreement with simple, polite negotiating phrases.
p: Proposing: Would you consider...? What if we...? How about...? Could we meet halfway?
Conditions: We could do that if you... I can agree to that, as long as...
Agreeing: That sounds fair. It's a deal. Let's go with that. Let me think about it and get back to you.
en.q: Have you ever negotiated something: a price at a market, a plan with friends or a task at work? How did it go?
en.c: Write a short negotiation between two people about a weekend plan using What if we...?, as long as and That sounds fair.
